objective_value: <float> Total number of time steps any attacker occupies the Defense Zone, plus the weighted cumulative control effort of all defenders.

defenders.x: <list[float], length N_u+1> X-coordinate of the defender's position at each control step.
defenders.y: <list[float], length N_u+1> Y-coordinate of the defender's position at each control step.
defenders.xdot: <list[float], length N_u+1> X-component of the defender's velocity at each control step.
defenders.ydot: <list[float], length N_u+1> Y-component of the defender's velocity at each control step.
defenders.ux: <list[float], length N_u> X-component of the defender's control input at each control step.
defenders.uy: <list[float], length N_u> Y-component of the defender's control input at each control step.

attackers.p: <list[float], length N_a+1> X-coordinate of the attacker's position at each sample step.
attackers.q: <list[float], length N_a+1> Y-coordinate of the attacker's position at each sample step.
attackers.a: <list[float], length N_a+1> Whether the attacker is in attack mode at each sample step (1 = attacking, 0 = inactive).
attackers.gamma: <list[float], length N_a+1> Whether the attacker is inside the Defense Zone at each sample step (1 = inside, 0 = outside).
attackers.delta: <list[list[float]], shape [N_D][N_a+1]> Per-defender interception indicator at each sample step; delta[i][k] = 1 iff defender i intercepts this attacker at step k, else 0.
